claim: The boot ROM-path check must credit bytes a build's own boot code restores, and treat a replaced BASIC loader prefix or an explicit entry boundary as needing its own exact boot proof.

evidence.text: A tail jumping to the build's boot code, which puts 0x5B00-0x5BFF back, was reported as read before written. The check now boots on to the game's PC and credits the bytes back.

A replaced BASIC loader prefix is not a runtime ROM path. An explicit entry boundary needs separate exact boot proof, records its first frame, rejects a missing entry and still catches later ROM faults.
